content.raw_text: 你成功挣脱了循环。

sentences.text: 你成功挣脱了循环。
sentences.translation: You successfully broke free from the loop.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is Subject + Adverb + Verb + Completion Indicator + Object. The tricky part for learners might be understanding the use of the verb '挣脱' (break free) in this context.

content.raw_text: 直到最后时间的巨轮重新恢复转动, 你都没琢磨明白自己为什么会进入循环, 又为什么结束循环，最后只能把一切归结于那个终于处理好的包裹。

sentences.text: 直到最后时间的巨轮重新恢复转动， 你都没琢磨明白自己为什么会进入循环，又为什么结束循环，最后只能把一切归结于那个终于处理好的包裹。
sentences.translation: Until the giant wheel of time started turning again, you never figured out why you entered the loop, nor why it ended. In the end, you could only attribute everything to that finally resolved package.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains complex structures like using '直到' (until) to indicate a time condition, as well as the use of '又' (nor) to connect two clauses. The repetition of '为什么' (why) emphasizes the confusion of the subject. The phrase '只能' (only able to) indicates a limitation in the subject's understanding.

content.raw_text: 仔细想想，姜医生是个治病救人的好医生，如果他没有出事, 这一辈子能救的人肯定有很多, 你救下了姜医生，就等于间接救下了许许多多的人, 从这一点上来看，也许老天爷卡住时间也要让你一次次尝试, 不是没意义的。

sentences.text: 仔细想想，姜医生是个治病救人的好医生，如果他没有出事， 这一辈子能救的人肯定有很多，你救下了姜医生，就等于间接救下了许许多多的人，从这一点上来看，也许老天爷卡住时间也要让你一次次尝试，不是没意义的。
sentences.translation: Think carefully, Dr. Jiang is a good doctor who saves lives. If he hadn't had an accident, he would have been able to save many people in his lifetime. By saving Dr. Jiang, you indirectly save many people. From this perspective, perhaps God is stopping time to let you try again and again, which is not meaningless.
sentences.explanation: The sentence discusses the idea that by saving one person (Dr. Jiang), you indirectly save many others. It also mentions the concept of God potentially giving you multiple chances to try again, implying a deeper meaning or purpose behind events.

content.raw_text: 肖鹤云那边也是一样, 因为他活下来了, 公交车里那么多乘客也都成功活了下来, 还有那些原本应该在爆炸案里被波及到的人……

sentences.text: 肖鹤云那边也是一样， 因为他活下来了，公交车里那么多乘客也都成功活了下来，还有那些原本应该在爆炸案里被波及到的人…
sentences.translation: Xiao Heyun over there is the same, because he survived, so many passengers on the bus also survived successfully, as well as those people who should have been affected by the explosion...
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes a situation where Xiao Heyun and many passengers on the bus survived, including those who were supposed to be affected by the explosion.

sentences.translation: The sentence to analyze is: ...
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains an ellipsis followed by a period, indicating an incomplete thought or pause in the text.

content.raw_text: 一想到肖鹤云是因为自己的提前预警避开生死大劫，你心里就美滋滋的。

sentences.text: 一想到肖鹤云是因为自己的提前预警避开生死大劫，你心里就美滋滋的。
sentences.translation: Thinking that Xiao Heyun was able to avoid a great calamity because of his early warning, you feel very happy in your heart.
sentences.explanation: The structure '一想到...，你心里就...' is a common way to express the cause and effect relationship in Chinese. The phrase '美滋滋' is an informal expression to describe feeling very happy or satisfied.

content.raw_text: 可能就是“做好事不留名”的快感吧。

sentences.text: 可能就是“做好事不留名”的快感吧。
sentences.translation: Perhaps it's the pleasure of 'doing good without leaving a name.'
sentences.explanation: The phrase '做好事不留名' means 'doing good deeds without seeking recognition.' The structure '可能就是' is a common way to express 'perhaps it is' in Chinese.

content.raw_text: 可惜, 上天并不想成全你“做好事不留名”的心愿。

sentences.text: 可惜， 上天并不想成全你“做好事不留名”的心愿。
sentences.translation: Unfortunately, heaven did not want to fulfill your wish of doing good deeds without leaving a name.
sentences.explanation: The structure '做好事不留名' is an idiom meaning 'doing good deeds without seeking recognition'.

content.raw_text: 因为公交车爆炸案, 姜医生被患者家属袭击的事情确实没有闹大，但姜医生却并没有因为这个就忽视了那位快递小哥的救命之恩, 第二天就给快递点送来了一面“见义勇为、智勇双全”的锦旗，并且打电话向你的公司表示感谢。

sentences.text: 因为公交车爆炸案， 姜医生被患者家属袭击的事情确实没有闹大，但姜医生却并没有因为这个就忽视了那位快递小哥的救命之恩，第二天就给快递点送来了一面“见义勇为，智勇双全”的锦旗，并且打电话向你的公司表示感谢。
sentences.translation: Because of the bus explosion incident, although the incident of Dr. Jiang being attacked by the patient's family did not escalate, Dr. Jiang did not neglect the lifesaving favor from the delivery guy. The next day, he sent a banner with the words 'brave and resourceful' to the delivery point and called your company to express gratitude.
sentences.explanation: The sentence showcases the use of possessive particles, passive markers, and the structure of expressing gratitude in Chinese culture.

content.raw_text: 你的公司本来就对这种“弘扬社会正能量”的好人好事设有奖励机制, 姜医生的锦旗一到, 你所在的快递点上上下下都受到了公司的表彰，这件事还上了公司的内部报刊。

sentences.text: 你的公司本来就对这种“弘扬社会正能量”的好人好事设有奖励机制， 姜医生的锦旗一到，你所在的快递点上上下下都受到了公司的表彰，这件事还上了公司的内部报刊。
sentences.translation: Your company originally had a reward mechanism for promoting positive energy in society. When Dr. Jiang's banner arrived, the express delivery point where you work received recognition from the company, and this matter was even reported in the company's internal newspaper.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of possessive '的' to indicate ownership or association, as well as the structure '...一到' to express 'when...arrived'. The phrase '上上下下' is an idiom meaning 'all around'.

content.raw_text: 你才刚刚和秦柔柔确定了恋爱关系, 女朋友长得漂亮又温柔，声音还好听，原本正是春风得意的时候, 结果第二天锦旗送来, 公司又特地让整个大区的负责人给你打了电话鼓励，并表示把你当成储备干部培养，真正是爱情事业双得意。

sentences.text: 你才刚刚和秦柔柔确定了恋爱关系， 女朋友长得漂亮又温柔，声音还好听，原本正是春风得意的时候，结果第二天锦旗送来，公司又特地让整个大区的负责人给你打了电话鼓励，并表示把你当成储备干部培养，真正是爱情事业双得意。
sentences.translation: You have just confirmed a romantic relationship with Qin Rourou. Your girlfriend is beautiful and gentle, with a nice voice. Just when you were feeling pleased with yourself, the next day a banner was sent, and the company specially had the head of the entire region call you to encourage you, saying they see you as a reserve cadre to be cultivated. Truly, both love and career are going well.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes a situation where the protagonist's romantic relationship is going well, but unexpected career opportunities arise, leading to a sense of accomplishment in both love and work.

content.raw_text: 姜医生的事情后来也有了后续，因为那个孩子的父亲是全家的经济来源，孩子又小还残疾了，在多方调解下，姜医生最终没有选择起诉伤人者，不过因此造成的损失还是要弥补的，伤人者赔偿了一笔医疗费给宋卜道，医院也因为你的见义勇为奖励了他一笔奖金，两笔钱加一起，也有个五、六万了。

sentences.text: 姜医生的事情后来也有了后续，因为那个孩子的父亲是全家的经济来源，孩子又小还残疾了，在多方调解下，姜医生最终没有选择起诉伤人者，不过因此造成的损失还是要弥补的，伤人者赔偿了一笔医疗费给宋卜道，医院也因为你的见义勇为奖励了他一笔奖金，两笔钱加一起，也有个五，六万了。
sentences.translation: Dr. Jiang's incident also had a follow-up. Because the father of that child was the family's economic provider, and the child was young and disabled, after various mediations, Dr. Jiang ultimately chose not to sue the person who injured him. However, the resulting losses still needed to be compensated for. The perpetrator compensated Song Bodao with a sum of medical expenses, and the hospital also rewarded him with a bonus for his act of righteousness. Adding the two sums together, it amounted to about fifty to sixty thousand.
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes the aftermath of an incident involving Dr. Jiang, where he chose not to sue the person who injured him due to the economic dependency of the child's family on the father. The sentence also highlights the compensation provided for the medical expenses and the bonus awarded to Dr. Jiang for his act of righteousness.

words.definition: particle indicating completion of an action

content.raw_text: 这也让你更加感慨医生的不易，对方明明都明刀明枪来砍人了，可迫于舆论和现实的压力，最后还是得同情弱者，毕竟医院也要名声，闹大了对哪一方都不好。

sentences.text: 这也让你更加感慨医生的不易，对方明明都明刀明枪来砍人了可迫于舆论和现实的压力，最后还是得同情弱者，毕竟医院也要名声，闹大了对哪一方都不好。
sentences.translation: This also makes you more aware of the difficulties of doctors. The other party clearly came to harm with a sharp knife and gun, but under the pressure of public opinion and reality, they still have to sympathize with the weak in the end. After all, hospitals also need a good reputation. Making a big fuss is not good for either side.
sentences.explanation: The sentence discusses the dilemma faced by doctors when dealing with difficult situations and the pressure from public opinion and the need to maintain a good reputation for the hospital.

content.raw_text: 人人都想着孩子父亲情有可原，谁又能想到姜医生上有老下有小？

sentences.text: 人人都想着孩子父亲情有可原，谁又能想到姜医生上有老下有小？
sentences.translation: Everyone thinks that the child's father's behavior is understandable, but who would have thought that Dr. Jiang has a lot of responsibilities?
sentences.explanation: The structure '上有老下有小' is a Chinese idiom used to describe someone who has many responsibilities, with '上' referring to older generations and '下' referring to younger generations.

content.raw_text: 听说姜医生这件事一结束就去报了个散打班，也不再主动给人加号了，下了班就去散打班练一会儿，早上还起来跑步，就是怕体能不好下次还遇到这种事，毕竟不是每次都有人来救的。

sentences.text: 听说姜医生这件事一结束就去报了个散打班，也不再主动给人加号了下了班就去散打班练一会儿早上还起来跑步就是怕体能不好下次还遇到这种事毕竟不是每次都有人来救的。
sentences.translation: I heard that Dr. Jiang finished this matter and immediately joined a Sanda class. He no longer actively adds people to the list. After work, he goes to the Sanda class to practice for a while. He also gets up in the morning to run, just to prevent encountering such things again due to poor physical fitness. After all, not every time someone will come to the rescue.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes Dr. Jiang's actions after finishing a certain matter, where he decides to join a Sanda class, stop actively adding people to a list, and focus on improving his physical fitness to prevent encountering similar situations in the future.

content.raw_text: 你中了一百注二等奖，扣税后得了一百万多一点的奖金。

sentences.text: 你中了一百注二等奖，扣税后得了一百万多一点的奖金。
sentences.translation: You won one hundred second prizes, and after tax, you received a little over one million in prize money.
sentences.explanation: The structure '一百注二等奖' uses the classifier '注' to indicate the number of prizes won. The phrase '扣税后' means 'after tax deduction'.

content.raw_text: 这一百万奖金虽然没办法在这个城市买套房子，但让你没有后顾之忧的做自己喜欢的事情却是够了。

sentences.text: 这一百万奖金虽然没办法在这个城市买套房子，但让你没有后顾之忧的做自己喜欢的事情却是够了。
sentences.translation: Although this one million prize cannot buy a house in this city, it is enough to let you do what you like without worries.
sentences.explanation: The structure '虽然...但...' means 'although...but...' in this sentence.

content.raw_text: 拿到钱后，你第一件事就是退了自己那间地下室，找了在补习班旁边的一室一厅单身公寓租了，虽然房子不大，可周围就是商业中心，干什么都方便，最重要的是，你已经住怕了地下室，这一间光线好的让人眯眼，房东还送了一阳台绿植。

sentences.text: 拿到钱后，你第一件事就是退了自己那间地下室，找了在补习班旁边的一室一厅单身公寓租了，虽然房子不大，可周围就是商业中心，干什么都方便，最重要的是，你已经住怕了地下室，这一间光线好的让人眯眼，房东还送了一阳台绿植。
sentences.translation: After receiving the money, the first thing you did was move out of your basement, rented a one-bedroom apartment next to the tutoring center. Although the apartment was small, it was located in a commercial center, making everything convenient. Most importantly, you were already afraid of living in the basement. This apartment had good lighting that made you squint, and the landlord even gave you a balcony with plants.
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes the protagonist's actions after receiving money, emphasizing their move from a basement to a small apartment in a commercial area due to the better living conditions and fear of the basement.

content.raw_text: 虽然楼层高，可作为一名快递员，你最不怕的就是爬楼。

sentences.text: 虽然楼层高，可作为一名快递员，你最不怕的就是爬楼。
sentences.translation: Although the floors are high, as a courier, the thing you fear the least is climbing stairs.
sentences.explanation: The structure '最不怕的就是' is a common way to express 'the thing you fear the least is'.

content.raw_text: 有了像样的住处，偶尔女朋友上门来坐坐，也不会那么局促了。

sentences.text: 有了像样的住处，偶尔女朋友上门来坐坐，也不会那么局促了。
sentences.translation: With a decent place to live, when my girlfriend occasionally comes over, it won't feel so cramped.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes how having a decent place to live makes it more comfortable when the girlfriend occasionally comes over.

content.raw_text: 住处和工作都稳定下来后，你白天送快递，晚上就去补习班上课，半年后参加了本市警官学院组织的考试，成功以退伍兵的身份考入了警官学院，体能测试是满分。

sentences.text: 住处和工作都稳定下来后，你白天送快递，晚上就去补习班上课，半年后参加了本市警官学院组织的考试，成功以退伍兵的身份考入了警官学院，体能测试是满分。
sentences.translation: After settling down in both residence and work, you deliver express during the day, attend tutoring classes at night, took the exam organized by the local police academy after half a year, successfully entered the police academy as a veteran, and scored full marks in the physical test.
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes the journey of the person from settling down in life to successfully entering the police academy as a veteran after passing the exam organized by the academy. It also highlights scoring full marks in the physical test.

content.raw_text: 你的父亲是牺牲的老兵，自己还是退伍兵，有多次见义勇为的经历，在政审这一关自然也是完全没问题的。

sentences.text: 你的父亲是牺牲的老兵，自己还是退伍兵，有多次见义勇为的经历，在政审这一关自然也是完全没问题的。
sentences.translation: Your father is a sacrificed veteran, himself a retired soldier, with multiple experiences of bravery. Naturally, he also passed the political review without any issues.
sentences.explanation: The sentence highlights the father's background as a veteran and retired soldier with a history of bravery, emphasizing his ability to pass the political review without any issues.

words.definition: act bravely in a just cause

content.raw_text: 考上学校的那一天，你正式向快递点辞了职，并且带着女朋友秦柔柔一起，请所有照顾过你的同事搓了一顿，算是饯别宴。

sentences.text: 考上学校的那一天，你正式向快递点辞了职并且带着女朋友秦柔柔一起，请所有照顾过你的同事搓了一顿，算是饯别宴。
sentences.translation: On the day you got into school, you officially resigned from the express delivery point, and with your girlfriend Qin Ruoruo, you invited all the colleagues who had taken care of you to have a meal together, which could be considered a farewell banquet.
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes a significant event where the person passes an exam to enter school, resigns from their job, and holds a farewell banquet with colleagues who have taken care of them.

words.definition: particle indicating completion of an action
particle indicating completion of an action

content.raw_text: 当天晚上，所有人喝得醉醺醺的，你的师傅哭得稀里哗啦，抓着你的手就嚎：

sentences.text: 当天晚上，所有人喝得醉醺醺的，你的师傅哭得稀里哗啦，抓着你的手就嚎：
sentences.translation: That night, everyone was drunk, your master cried loudly, grabbing your hand and wailing:
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes a scene where everyone is drunk, the master is crying loudly, and grabbing the listener's hand to wail.

content.raw_text: “我是真喜欢你这个小伙子啊！做事勤快又有分寸，吃苦耐劳不说，人也不抠唆，还这么上进！我要是有你这么个儿子，我死而无憾了啊！”

sentences.text: “我是真喜欢你这个小伙子啊！
sentences.translation: I really like you, this young man!
sentences.explanation: The structure '真喜欢' means 'really like' in this context. The particle '啊' is used to express emphasis or emotion.

sentences.text: 做事勤快又有分寸，吃苦耐劳不说，人也不抠唆，还这么上进！
sentences.translation: Work diligently and sensibly, endure hardships without complaining, not nitpicking, and still so motivated!
sentences.explanation: This sentence praises someone who works diligently, sensibly, endures hardships without complaining, does not nitpick, and remains motivated. The structure '又...又...' is used to express multiple qualities or actions in a positive light.

sentences.text: 我要是有你这么个儿子，我死而无憾了啊！
sentences.translation: If I had a son like you, I would die without regrets!
sentences.explanation: The structure '要是...，我...了啊' is a conditional sentence expressing a hypothetical situation and the speaker's emotional response to it.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating a pause or continuation in the text.

content.raw_text: 他一把鼻涕一把泪，“我就知道你书肯定能读出来的，就没想到这么快！”

sentences.text: 他一把鼻涕一把泪，“我就知道你书肯定能读出来的，就没想到这么快！
sentences.translation: He had snot and tears all over, "I knew you could definitely read the book, just didn't expect it to be so soon!
sentences.explanation: The structure '一把...一把...' is used to express the presence of two different things in abundance. The particle '的' is used to indicate past tense in this context.

sentences.translation: The sentence to analyze is: ""
sentences.explanation: The sentence is enclosed in quotation marks, indicating that it is a direct quote or specific text being referenced.

content.raw_text: 这半年来，你晚上上课也没藏着掖着，你向来是个光明磊落的人，早几个月就提了自己在恶补高中课程的事情，也提了自己以后想去当警察，圆一个部队梦。

sentences.text: 这半年来，你晚上上课也没藏着掖着，你向来是个光明磊落的人，早几个月就提了自己在恶补高中课程的事情，也提了自己以后想去当警察，圆一个部队梦。
sentences.translation: In the past half year, you haven't hidden anything when attending classes at night. You have always been an upright person. A few months ago, you mentioned that you were catching up on high school courses and that you plan to become a police officer in the future, fulfilling a dream of joining the military.
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes the actions and aspirations of the person being addressed, highlighting their honesty and determination to pursue a career as a police officer after catching up on high school courses.

content.raw_text: 现在你好梦成真，大家都为你高兴，可是舍不得也是真舍不得。

sentences.text: 现在你好梦成真，大家都为你高兴，可是舍不得也是真舍不得。
sentences.translation: Now your dream has come true, everyone is happy for you, but they are reluctant to let go, it's true.
sentences.explanation: The repetition of '舍不得' emphasizes the feeling of reluctance to let go, which is a common sentiment in Chinese culture.

content.raw_text: 眼见着师傅哭成这样，秦柔柔想了想，在你耳边说了点什么。

sentences.text: 眼见着师傅哭成这样，秦柔柔想了想，在你耳边说了点什么。
sentences.translation: Seeing the master cry like this, Qin RouRou thought for a moment and said something in your ear.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes a moment where Qin RouRou observes the master crying and decides to whisper something in the listener's ear.

content.raw_text: “师傅，您要不嫌弃我，我就给你当个儿子！”

sentences.text: “师傅，您要不嫌弃我，我就给你当个儿子！
sentences.translation: Master, if you don't mind, I'll be your son!
sentences.explanation: The speaker is offering to be like a son to the master, showing respect and willingness to serve.
The sentence contains opening and closing quotation marks, indicating a direct quote.

content.raw_text: 这半年来，师傅一直在照顾着你，工作上手把手教导，生活也是嘘寒问暖。

sentences.text: 这半年来，师傅一直在照顾着你，工作上手把手教导，生活也是嘘寒问暖。
sentences.translation: Over the past half year, the master has been taking care of you, guiding you hand in hand at work, and also showing concern for you in daily life.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes the master's continuous care and guidance for the person over the past half year, both in work and daily life.

content.raw_text: 你搬家都是师傅帮的，厨房里锅碗瓢盆这些东西也都是他归置好了送过来的。

sentences.text: 你搬家都是师傅帮的，厨房里锅碗瓢盆这些东西也都是他归置好了送过来。
sentences.translation: You moved, all done by the master, the kitchen pots and pans and such were also arranged and sent over by him.
sentences.explanation: The sentence showcases the use of '都' (all) to emphasize that everything was done by the master. The structure '...也都是...' is used to express that something was also done by someone.

words.definition: particle indicating past tense or emphasis

content.raw_text: “我亲爸去世的早，是个没爹没娘的孩子，我认你做干爸，以后孝顺你，病了痛了照顾你！”

sentences.text: “我亲爸去世的早，是个没爹没娘的孩子，我认你做干爸，以后孝顺你，病了痛了照顾你！
sentences.translation: My biological father passed away early, I am a child without parents, I acknowledge you as my godfather, in the future, I will take care of you when you are sick or in pain!
sentences.explanation: The speaker is expressing their willingness to take care of the person they acknowledge as their godfather in the future, especially when they are sick or in pain. The use of '干爸' (godfather) is a cultural term in Chinese society to refer to a close male figure who takes on a fatherly role in a child's life.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating a continuation or omission of text.

content.raw_text: 你在师傅的耳边大声说。

sentences.text: 你在师傅的耳边大声说。
sentences.translation: You loudly say by the master's ear.
sentences.explanation: The structure '在...的...' is used to indicate the location where an action takes place. In this sentence, '在师傅的耳边' means 'by the master's ear'.

content.raw_text: 这句话一出，所有人都惊呆了。

sentences.text: 这句话一出，所有人都惊呆了。
sentences.translation: As soon as this sentence was spoken, everyone was shocked.
sentences.explanation: The structure '一出' here indicates that something was spoken or said, leading to the reaction described in the sentence.

content.raw_text: 师傅不是个有本事的人，否则当年老婆也不会跑掉，人是真的好，也特别仗义，但是在自身都难保的那个年代，这就成了一个缺点，连自己的家庭也保不住。

sentences.text: 师傅不是个有本事的人，否则当年老婆也不会跑掉，人是真的好，也特别仗义，但是在自身都难保的那个年代，这就成了一个缺点，连自己的家庭也保不住。
sentences.translation: The master is not a capable person, otherwise his wife would not have run away back then. He is truly kind and especially righteous, but in an era where even one's own safety is hard to guarantee, this becomes a flaw, unable to even protect his own family.
sentences.explanation: This sentence reflects on the master's character and the challenges he faces in a tumultuous era, where even personal safety is not guaranteed.

content.raw_text: 后来时代好了，就业机会多了，他在这家业界最有名的快递公司勤勤恳恳干了近十年，虽然没当上组长，可收入和组长也差不多，但说到底，也就是个快递员。

sentences.text: 后来时代好了，就业机会多了，他在这家业界最有名的快递公司勤勤恳恳干了近十年，虽然没当上组长，可收入和组长也差不多，但说到底，也就是个快递员。
sentences.translation: In the later era when the times were better and there were more job opportunities, he worked diligently at this most famous express delivery company in the industry for nearly ten years. Although he didn't become a team leader, his income was similar to that of a team leader. But in the end, he was just an express delivery person.
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes the protagonist's experience working diligently at an express delivery company for nearly ten years, despite not being promoted to a team leader. It highlights the similarity in income between the protagonist and a team leader, ultimately emphasizing that he is just an express delivery person.

content.raw_text: 可是你愿意认他做干爸，两个家庭都不幸福的人，最了解对方渴望着什么。

sentences.text: 可是你愿意认他做干爸，两个家庭都不幸福的人，最了解对方渴望着什么。
sentences.translation: But if you are willing to recognize him as a godfather, two families that are both unhappy, the people who understand each other the most, know what each other desires.
sentences.explanation: The sentence discusses the understanding between two people who are willing to recognize each other as godparents, despite both coming from unhappy families.

content.raw_text: 当即，师傅哭得更厉害了，眼泪汪汪地收下了你这个“干儿子”。

sentences.text: 当即，师傅哭得更厉害了，眼泪汪汪地收下了你这个“干儿子”。
sentences.translation: Immediately, the master cried even harder, tears streaming down as he accepted you as his 'godson'.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of the particle '了' to indicate a change of situation. The term '干儿子' refers to the relationship of a godparent and their godchild, which is a significant bond in Chinese culture.

content.raw_text: 在所有人的见证下，你按照家乡的做法，跪下来给师傅敬了杯酒，喊了一声“爸”，这就等于是互相承认了身份了。

sentences.text: 在所有人的见证下，你按照家乡的做法，跪下来给师傅敬了杯酒，喊了一声“爸”，这就等于是互相承认了身份了。
sentences.translation: In the presence of everyone, you knelt down according to the customs of your hometown, respectfully offered a cup of wine to the master, and called out 'Dad,' which is equivalent to acknowledging each other's identities.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases a cultural practice of showing respect and acknowledgment by offering wine to a master and calling them 'Dad'. The structure '这就等于是' means 'this is equivalent to'.

content.raw_text: 公司同事们看着你们这样心里也开心，酒是喝了一瓶又一瓶，最后各个都颠颠倒倒的回了家。

sentences.text: 公司同事们看着你们这样心里也开心，酒是喝了一瓶又一瓶，最后各个都颠颠倒倒的回了家。
sentences.translation: Colleagues at the company are happy to see you like this, drinking bottle after bottle of wine, and finally each of them staggered home.
sentences.explanation: The structure '最后各个都' emphasizes that each person ended up in a certain state, in this case, staggering home.

content.raw_text: 秦柔柔将你送回了单身公寓，临走前，你抓着她的手不放。

sentences.text: 秦柔柔将你送回了单身公寓，临走前，你抓着她的手不放。
sentences.translation: Qin Rou Rou sent you back to the single apartment. Before leaving, you held onto her hand and didn't let go.
sentences.explanation: The structure '抓着' indicates holding onto something continuously, and '不放' means 'not letting go'.

content.raw_text: “柔柔，我有爸爸了！”

sentences.text: “柔柔，我有爸爸了！
sentences.translation: Softly, I have a dad!
sentences.explanation: The repetition of "柔柔" adds emphasis to the soft and gentle tone. The use of "了" at the end of the sentence indicates a change or completion of having a dad.
The sentence ends with an ellipsis enclosed in quotation marks.

content.raw_text: 你哼唧着。

sentences.text: 你哼唧着。
sentences.translation: You hummed.
sentences.explanation: The structure '哼唧着' indicates the continuous action of humming.

content.raw_text: “嗯嗯。”

sentences.text: “嗯嗯。
sentences.translation: Hmm.
sentences.explanation: The repetition of the interjection '嗯' indicates a thoughtful or contemplative response in Chinese conversation.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating a pause or omission in the text.

content.raw_text: 秦柔柔给你擦脸。

sentences.text: 秦柔柔给你擦脸。
sentences.translation: Qin Rou Rou wipes your face for you.
sentences.explanation: The structure '给你' means 'for you' in this context. The repetition of the character '柔' in the name '秦柔柔' is a common practice in Chinese names to create a gentle and harmonious sound.

content.raw_text: “我也有女朋友了！”

sentences.text: “我也有女朋友了！
sentences.translation: I also have a girlfriend!
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is Subject + 也 + Verb + Object + 了, indicating the speaker also has a girlfriend now.

sentences.explanation: The sentence simply means 'Good!' in English. The exclamation mark emphasizes the speaker's positive sentiment.
The sentence contains a closing quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating that there is more text following this sentence.

content.raw_text: 秦柔柔翻了个白眼。

sentences.text: 秦柔柔翻了个白眼。
sentences.translation: Qin Rou Rou rolled her eyes.
sentences.explanation: The structure '翻了个白眼' means 'rolled her eyes'. The measure word '个' is used before '眼' to indicate counting of eyes.

content.raw_text: “柔柔，我以后会对你好的，一辈子都对你好！”

sentences.text: “柔柔，我以后会对你好的，一辈子都对你好！
sentences.translation: Rourou, I will treat you well in the future, I will treat you well for a lifetime!
sentences.explanation: The speaker is expressing a promise to treat the listener well in the future and for a lifetime. The repetition of '柔柔' adds emphasis to the gentleness and sincerity of the promise.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 你声音温柔的一塌糊涂。

sentences.text: 你声音温柔的一塌糊涂。
sentences.translation: Your voice is extremely gentle.
sentences.explanation: The structure '一塌糊涂' is a common Chinese idiom used to emphasize the degree of an adjective. In this sentence, it emphasizes how gentle the voice is.

words.definition: particle indicating an attribute or property
extremely (used to emphasize the preceding adjective)

content.raw_text: “我知道，我相信。”

sentences.text: “我知道，我相信。
sentences.translation: I know, I believe.
sentences.explanation: This sentence consists of two simple declarative statements: 'I know' and 'I believe.' The tricky part may be the use of two consecutive pronouns '我' (I/me) in Mandarin Chinese, which is common in this language.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark followed by an ellipsis, indicating a continuation or omission of text.

content.raw_text: 秦柔柔叹了口气，擦了擦你的脸。

sentences.text: 秦柔柔叹了口气，擦了擦你的脸。
sentences.translation: Qin Rou Rou sighed, wiped your face.
sentences.explanation: The repetition of the character '柔' in the name '秦柔柔' is a common literary device in Chinese to emphasize softness or gentleness. The use of '了' after a verb indicates the completion of the action, in this case, sighing and wiping.

content.raw_text: “你要等我啊，等我出来当个警官，就有底气娶你了，否则你家里人怎么能同意呢？等我娶了你，我就又有了家了。”

sentences.text: “你要等我啊，等我出来当个警官，就有底气娶你了，否则你家里人怎么能同意呢？
sentences.translation: You have to wait for me, wait for me to become a police officer, then I will have the confidence to marry you. Otherwise, how can your family agree?
sentences.explanation: The sentence uses conditional structures and future tense to express a hypothetical situation. The word '底气' (confidence) is used in a figurative sense here.

words.definition: (particle indicating completion or change of situation)

sentences.text: 等我娶了你，我就又有了家了。
sentences.translation: When I marry you, I will have a family again.
sentences.explanation: The structure '等...，就...' is a common way to express a conditional relationship in Chinese. In this sentence, the speaker is saying that once they marry the listener, they will have a family again.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark followed by an ellipsis, indicating a continuation or omission of text.

content.raw_text: 你反复嘟囔着这一句，“真好，我又有家了，就快有家了。我妈该多高兴啊……”

sentences.text: 你反复嘟囔着这一句，“真好，我又有家了，就快有家了。
sentences.translation: You repeatedly murmured this sentence, 'It's great, I have a home again, I will have a home soon.'
sentences.explanation: The structure '又...了' indicates the repetition of an action or state, emphasizing the speaker's feeling of having something again. The use of '就' and '快' together intensifies the idea of something happening soon.

indicates completion or change of state

sentences.text: 我妈该多高兴啊…
sentences.translation: My mom must be so happy...
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is subject + modal verb + adverb + adjective + exclamatory particle. The use of '啊' at the end adds an exclamatory tone to the sentence.

sentences.translation: The sky was clear, the moon was bright.
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes the weather condition with the sky being clear and the moon shining brightly.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark followed by an ellipsis, indicating a pause or continuation of thought.

sentences.text: 秦柔柔鼻子一酸，终于没忍住，眼泪掉了下来。
sentences.translation: Qin Rourou's nose felt sour, finally couldn't hold back, tears fell down.
sentences.explanation: The structure '一...就...' indicates that once something happens, another action follows immediately. In this sentence, '一酸' means 'felt sour' and '没忍住' means 'couldn't hold back'.

content.raw_text: “会有的。”

sentences.text: “会有的。
sentences.translation: There will be.
sentences.explanation: This sentence is a simple statement indicating that something will happen in the future. The use of 的 at the end adds emphasis and certainty to the statement.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating a pause or omission in the text.

sentences.text: 她趴在你的胸前，揽着你的脖子说，“像你这么好的人，什么都会有的。
sentences.translation: She lies on your chest, embraces your neck, and says, 'A good person like you will have everything.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is straightforward, but pay attention to the use of '像...这么...' to express 'like...such...' and the particle '的' at the end of '好的人' for emphasis.

sentences.explanation: This sentence indicates the conclusion of the chapter.

content.raw_text: 几年后，你从学校的侦查学专业毕业了，一毕业，你就参加了当年十月的公安机关招警考试，你怕再拖下去岁数又超过年龄限制了。

sentences.text: 几年后，你从学校的侦查学专业毕业了，一毕业，你就参加了当年十月的公安机关招警考试，你怕再拖下去岁数又超过年龄限制了。
sentences.translation: A few years later, you graduated from the school's investigative major. As soon as you graduated, you took the police recruitment exam in October of that year. You were afraid that if you delayed any longer, you would exceed the age limit.
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes a sequence of events where the person graduates from school and immediately takes a police recruitment exam to avoid exceeding the age limit.

content.raw_text: 因为你在学校的成绩优异，体能优秀，身体素质又好，整个考试过程中，无论笔试面试和体能测试都是极好的成绩，成功被市刑警大队录取，成为了一名光荣的人民警察。

sentences.text: 因为你在学校的成绩优异，体能优秀，身体素质又好，整个考试过程中，无论笔试面试和体能测试都是极好的成绩，成功被市刑警大队录取，成为了一名光荣的人民警察。
sentences.translation: Because of your excellent performance in school, outstanding physical fitness, and good physical quality, throughout the entire examination process, whether it was the written test, interview, or physical fitness test, you achieved excellent results, and were successfully recruited by the city criminal police brigade, becoming a proud people's police officer.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases a complex structure with multiple clauses and adjectives. It also highlights the importance of academic performance, physical fitness, and overall quality in the recruitment process for a police officer.

content.raw_text: 去报道那天，已经成为知名编剧的秦柔柔开车送你去报道。

sentences.text: 去报道那天，已经成为知名编剧的秦柔柔开车送你去报道。
sentences.translation: On the day of the interview, Qin Rou Rou, who had already become a well-known screenwriter, drove you to the interview.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of the possessive particle '的' to indicate the relationship between the well-known screenwriter Qin Rou Rou and the action of driving '开车' and sending '送' someone to an interview '报道'.

content.raw_text: 两年前，秦柔柔编写的剧本《无尽循环》被拍成电影，当年一炮而红，成为了那年度影视圈的一匹大黑马，之后她又出品了好几部脑洞大立意又新的电视剧，关注的还是底层百姓的社会民生，渐渐在圈里有了名气。

sentences.text: 两年前，秦柔柔编写的剧本《无尽循环》被拍成电影，当年一炮而红，成为了那年度影视圈的一匹大黑马，之后她又出品了好几部脑洞大立意又新的电视剧，关注的还是底层百姓的社会民生，渐渐在圈里有了名气。
sentences.translation: Two years ago, the script "Endless Loop" written by Qin Rou was made into a movie. It became a big hit that year, becoming a dark horse in the film and television industry. Afterwards, she produced several innovative TV dramas with big ideas, still focusing on the social livelihood of the grassroots people, gradually gaining fame in the industry.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the success story of a scriptwriter turned producer in the film and television industry. It includes vocabulary related to the entertainment industry and creative works, as well as expressions indicating success and progression in one's career.

content.raw_text: 现在的她可谓是已经名利双收，但是“宅”属性和爱男友这两点却是万年不变。

sentences.text: 现在的她可谓是已经名利双收，但是“宅”属性和爱男友这两点却是万年不变。
sentences.translation: Now she can be said to have already achieved both fame and fortune, but her 'homebody' nature and love for her boyfriend have remained unchanged for thousands of years.
sentences.explanation: The structure '可谓是' is a common way to express that something can be said to be a certain way. The phrase '万年不变' literally means 'unchanged for thousands of years' and is used to emphasize the longevity of a certain characteristic or behavior.

content.raw_text: 为了不让你和她见面难，她在荷包丰厚后就在你所在的警官学院旁边买了一间单身公寓，后来你被刑警队录取，她又准备在刑警队旁边买间房，所有人都在你面前打趣，说她是打定主意要当“警嫂”了。

sentences.text: 为了不让你和她见面难，她在荷包丰厚后就在你所在的警官学院旁边买了一间单身公寓，后来你被刑警队录取，她又准备在刑警队旁边买间房，所有人都在你面前打趣，说她是打定主意要当“警嫂”了。
sentences.translation: In order to make it easier for you to not meet her, after she became wealthy, she bought a single apartment next to the police academy where you are, and later when you were recruited by the criminal police team, she prepared to buy a house next to the criminal police team. Everyone teases you, saying she has decided to become a 'police wife'.
sentences.explanation: This sentence involves complex sentence structure with multiple clauses and cultural references related to the idea of becoming a 'police wife'.

content.raw_text: 你没有什么“吃软饭”、“被女人包养”之类的狭隘偏见，听说女朋友要在市局旁边买房子，就把自己存下来的一百多万都给了她，让她去买房，也没问产权之类的事情。

sentences.text: 你没有什么“吃软饭”，“被女人包养”之类的狭隘偏见，听说女朋友要在市局旁边买房子，就把自己存下来的一百多万都给了她，让她去买房，也没问产权之类的事情。
sentences.translation: You don't have any narrow prejudices like 'living off a woman' or 'being kept by a woman'. I heard that your girlfriend wants to buy a house next to the city bureau, so you gave her all the more than one million yuan you saved, let her go buy a house, and didn't ask about property rights and the like.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes a person who doesn't hold narrow prejudices and generously gives all the money saved to his girlfriend to buy a house without asking about property rights.

content.raw_text: 去报道的路上，秦柔柔把房产证从手套箱里拿出来，递给了你。

sentences.text: 去报道的路上，秦柔柔把房产证从手套箱里拿出来，递给了你。
sentences.translation: On the way to the interview, Qin Rou Rou took out the property deed from the glove compartment and handed it to you.
sentences.explanation: The structure '把...从...' is a common way in Chinese to indicate taking something out from somewhere and then doing something with it.

content.raw_text: “房子的产证下来了，首付二百二十万，我们两个正好一人一半。”

sentences.text: “房子的产证下来了，首付二百二十万，我们两个正好一人一半。
sentences.translation: The property deed for the house has come, with a down payment of two million two hundred thousand. The two of us will split it evenly.
sentences.explanation: This sentence demonstrates the use of the word '正好' to indicate that the two people will split the down payment evenly, with each person paying half.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark followed by an ellipsis, indicating a continuation or omission of text.

content.raw_text: 她笑着说。

sentences.text: 她笑着说。
sentences.translation: She smiled and said.
sentences.explanation: The use of the particle '着' after a verb indicates that the action is in progress. In this sentence, it emphasizes that she was smiling while speaking.

content.raw_text: “什么一人一半？”

sentences.text: “什么一人一半？
sentences.translation: What one person one half?
sentences.explanation: The sentence is asking about the concept of 'one person one half', which may refer to a proverb, a question about sharing, or some other context-specific meaning.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating a continuation or omission of text.

content.raw_text: 你以为这次又是和之前一样买个三四十平方的单身公寓，茫然地翻开产证，结果看见上面是一百二十个平方的三室居，产权人是两个人的名字，抬起头来又看她。

sentences.text: 你以为这次又是和之前一样买个三四十平方的单身公寓，茫然地翻开产证，结果看见上面是一百二十个平方的三室居，产权人是两个人的名字，抬起头来又看她。
sentences.translation: You thought this time it would be the same as before, buying a single apartment of thirty to forty square meters, absentmindedly flipping through the property certificate, only to see that it was a one hundred and twenty square meter three-bedroom residence, owned by two people, and then you looked up to see her.
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a complex structure with multiple clauses and descriptive phrases. The use of classifiers like "个" for counting objects and the specific measurement term "平方" for square meters are common in Chinese. The sentence also demonstrates the use of possessive structures with "的" and the verb-object sequence typical in Chinese grammar.

content.raw_text: “怎么买的这么大？”

sentences.text: “怎么买的这么大？
sentences.translation: How did you buy such a big one?
sentences.explanation: The structure '怎么...这么...' is commonly used to express surprise or disbelief, similar to 'how...such...' in English.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark followed by a period.

content.raw_text: “以后要养孩子，还有我的书房，不大点不行啊。”

sentences.text: “以后要养孩子，还有我的书房，不大点不行啊。
sentences.translation: In the future, when raising children, my study must be bigger.
sentences.explanation: The structure '不大点不行' is a common way to express that something must be a little bigger.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating a pause or continuation in the text.

content.raw_text: 秦柔柔不动神色地说。

sentences.text: 秦柔柔不动神色地说。
sentences.translation: Qin Rou Rou said calmly.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese places the subject before the verb, and adverbs like '地' are used to modify the verb.

content.raw_text: 你明白了她话里的意思，眼睛一亮，激动的说不出话来。

sentences.text: 你明白了她话里的意思，眼睛一亮，激动的说不出话来。
sentences.translation: You understood the meaning in her words, your eyes lit up, excitedly unable to speak.
sentences.explanation: The structure '说不出话来' is a common Chinese expression meaning 'unable to speak' or 'at a loss for words'.

content.raw_text: “你看，这是我们两个的房子，还有那么多贷款呢，以后每月贷款是要一起还的，你说，我们拿什么名义还贷款啊？”

sentences.text: “你看，这是我们两个的房子，还有那么多贷款呢，以后每月贷款是要一起还的，你说，我们拿什么名义还贷款啊？
sentences.translation: You see, this is our house, and there is still so much loan. In the future, we will have to repay the loan together every month. What reason do you think we should use to repay the loan?
sentences.explanation: This sentence discusses the shared responsibility of repaying a loan for a house and questions the reason or justification for doing so.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating a continuation or omission of text.

content.raw_text: 秦柔柔对男友眨了眨眼。

sentences.text: 秦柔柔对男友眨了眨眼。
sentences.translation: Qin Rou Rou blinked at her boyfriend.
sentences.explanation: The structure '对...眨了眨眼' means 'blinked at'.

content.raw_text: “夫妻！果断要用夫妻名义！”

sentences.text: “夫妻！
sentences.translation: Husband and wife!
sentences.explanation: This sentence is a direct address to a husband and wife, using the exclamation mark to convey emphasis or urgency.

sentences.text: 果断要用夫妻名义！
sentences.translation: Decisively use the name of husband and wife!
sentences.explanation: The sentence emphasizes the importance of decisively using the name of husband and wife for a certain purpose.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating a pause or continuation in the text.

content.raw_text: 你这时候倒是不笨了，连忙拍板。

sentences.text: 你这时候倒是不笨了，连忙拍板。
sentences.translation: You are not stupid at this moment, hurry up and make a decision.
sentences.explanation: The phrase '倒是' is used to emphasize that the person is not stupid at this moment. '拍板' is an idiomatic phrase meaning to make a decision or agree to something.

words.definition: particle indicating a change of situation/state

content.raw_text: “等下我就去请个假，请了师傅当个见证人，把结婚证领了！”

sentences.text: “等下我就去请个假，请了师傅当个见证人，把结婚证领了！
sentences.translation: I will go ask for a leave in a moment, invite the master as a witness, and get the marriage certificate!
sentences.explanation: The sentence involves the use of particles like '了' and '把' which have specific functions in Chinese grammar. The structure '把 + object + verb' is used to indicate the object affected by the verb, and '了' is used to indicate completion of an action.

words.definition: particle indicating the object of a verb

sentences.explanation: The sentence ends with a quotation mark followed by an ellipsis, indicating a continuation or omission of text.

content.raw_text: 这几年过年，你都是在秦柔柔的老家过的，她的家人对你很满意，要不是你还在读书，早就催促你们结婚了。

sentences.text: 这几年过年，你都是在秦柔柔的老家过的，她的家人对你很满意，要不是你还在读书，早就催促你们结婚了。
sentences.translation: In recent years during the Chinese New Year, you have always celebrated at Qin Rou Rou's hometown. Her family is very satisfied with you. If you weren't still studying, they would have urged you to get married already.
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes the situation of the listener celebrating Chinese New Year at Qin Rou Rou's hometown for several years. It also mentions that Qin Rou Rou's family is pleased with the listener and would have urged them to get married if the listener wasn't still studying.

content.raw_text: 你考虑到自己工作还没稳定，不愿女朋友在老家被人笑话，一直坚持工作了才结婚，否则对她的家人没交代。

sentences.text: 你考虑到自己工作还没稳定，不愿女朋友在老家被人笑话，一直坚持工作了才结婚，否则对她的家人没交代。
sentences.translation: You consider that your work is not stable yet, unwilling for your girlfriend to be laughed at in her hometown, insisting on getting married only after working steadily, otherwise you would not be able to face her family.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes the speaker's consideration of marriage, taking into account the stability of their work and the reputation of their girlfriend in her hometown.

content.raw_text: 现在，你已经成了一名公务员，光荣的警察，虽然谈不上什么大富大贵，但你觉得你可以给她带来荣誉、安全感和幸福。

sentences.text: 现在，你已经成了一名公务员，光荣的警察，虽然谈不上什么大富大贵，但你觉得你可以给她带来荣誉，安全感和幸福。
sentences.translation: Now, you have become a civil servant, a honorable police officer, although not very wealthy, you feel you can bring her honor, security, and happiness.
sentences.explanation: The sentence introduces the idea of the speaker becoming a civil servant and a police officer, emphasizing the honor and ability to provide honor, security, and happiness to someone.

content.raw_text: “这才上班第一天，会不会不太好？”

sentences.text: “这才上班第一天，会不会不太好？
sentences.translation: This is only the first day of work, could it not be too good?
sentences.explanation: The structure '会不会' is used to express uncertainty or possibility in a question, similar to 'could it' in English.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark followed by an ellipsis, indicating a continuation or omission of text.

content.raw_text: 秦柔柔没想到你行动力这么快，也跟着懵了。

sentences.text: 秦柔柔没想到你行动力这么快，也跟着懵了。
sentences.translation: Qin Rou Rou didn't expect you to act so quickly, and she was also stunned.
sentences.explanation: The structure '也跟着' means 'also followed', indicating that Qin Rou Rou was surprised along with someone else.

content.raw_text: “我觉得会被理解的！”

sentences.text: “我觉得会被理解的！
sentences.translation: I feel like I will be understood!
sentences.explanation: The structure '会被' indicates passive voice, where the subject receives the action. The particle '的' at the end of the sentence adds emphasis.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark followed by an ellipsis, indicating a continuation or omission of text.

content.raw_text: 你笑嘻嘻的说，“上班纪念日和结婚纪念日在一起，多有意义啊！”

sentences.text: 你笑嘻嘻的说，“上班纪念日和结婚纪念日在一起，多有意义啊！
sentences.translation: You smiled and said, 'Having the work anniversary and wedding anniversary together is so meaningful!'
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of adverbial phrases in Chinese, where the adverbial phrase '笑嘻嘻' (smiling) describes how the action of speaking '说' (said) is carried out.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating a pause or continuation in the text.

content.raw_text: 你被送到了刑警大队门口，已经有人在门口等着。

sentences.text: 你被送到了刑警大队门口，已经有人在门口等着。
sentences.translation: You were taken to the entrance of the criminal police brigade, and someone was already waiting at the entrance.
sentences.explanation: The sentence uses the passive voice structure with the passive marker '被'. The word '已经' is used to indicate that the action of waiting has already started.

content.raw_text: “你就是新来的小宋吧？我是带你熟悉情况的同事，以后也负责带你，我姓张。”

sentences.text: “你就是新来的小宋吧？
sentences.translation: Are you the new Xiao Song?
sentences.explanation: The sentence is a simple question asking if the person addressed is the new person named Xiao Song.

words.definition: modal particle indicating suggestion or assumption

sentences.text: 我是带你熟悉情况的同事，以后也负责带你，我姓张。
sentences.translation: I am a colleague who will familiarize you with the situation, and I will also be responsible for guiding you. My last name is Zhang.
sentences.explanation: The structure '带你' means 'guide you'. The word '姓' is used to indicate one's last name.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating an unfinished thought or continuation.

content.raw_text: 一张熟悉的面孔出现在你的面前。

sentences.text: 一张熟悉的面孔出现在你的面前。
sentences.translation: A familiar face appears in front of you.
sentences.explanation: The structure '一...出现在...' means 'one...appears in/at...'. The possessive particle '的' is used to form an adjective in this context.

words.definition: measure word for flat objects like paper, pictures, etc.
possessive particle, used before a noun to form an adjective

content.raw_text: 你怔愣住了。

sentences.text: 你怔愣住了。
sentences.translation: You stood there in a daze.
sentences.explanation: The phrase 怔愣 means to be in a daze or stunned, which might be a new vocabulary for intermediate learners.

content.raw_text: “怎么？我长得很吓人吗？”

sentences.text: “怎么？
sentences.translation: How?
sentences.explanation: The word 怎么 (how) is used to inquire about a manner or way of doing something. It is a common question word in Chinese.

sentences.text: 我长得很吓人吗？
sentences.translation: Do I look very scary?
sentences.explanation: The structure '长得很' is used to describe one's appearance, followed by an adjective.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating a continuation or omission of text.

content.raw_text: 老张见你一直对他脸上打量，纳闷地摸了摸自己的脸。

sentences.text: 老张见你一直对他脸上打量，纳闷地摸了摸自己的脸。
sentences.translation: Old Zhang saw you staring at his face all the time, puzzled, and touched his own face.
sentences.explanation: The structure '对...打量' means 'staring at'. The use of '纳闷' indicates being puzzled or confused.

content.raw_text: “没。只是你长得很像我一个熟人。”

sentences.translation: No.
sentences.explanation: The word "没" in this context means "no" or "not".

sentences.text: 只是你长得很像我一个熟人。
sentences.translation: It's just that you look very much like an acquaintance of mine.
sentences.explanation: The structure '长得很像' is a common way to express that someone looks like someone else in Chinese.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating a pause or omission in the text.

content.raw_text: 你想起那次循环里老张通红的眼眶，对自己未来的人际关系大有信心，也更加期待。

sentences.text: 你想起那次循环里老张通红的眼眶，对自己未来的人际关系大有信心，也更加期待。
sentences.translation: You remember the time when Old Zhang's eyes were red in that cycle, having great confidence in your future interpersonal relationships, and also looking forward more.
sentences.explanation: The structure '对...有信心' means 'have confidence in...' and '也更加' emphasizes 'also more'.

content.raw_text: 这是个好警察啊。

sentences.text: 这是个好警察啊。
sentences.translation: This is a good police officer.
sentences.explanation: The structure '这是个' is a common way to introduce or describe someone or something in Chinese.

content.raw_text: “那好，我先带你熟悉熟悉……”

sentences.text: “那好，我先带你熟悉熟悉…
sentences.translation: Well, then, let me first familiarize you with...
sentences.explanation: The repetition of the word '熟悉' adds emphasis to the action of familiarizing someone with something.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark followed by an ellipsis, indicating a pause or continuation in the text.

content.raw_text: “报告！”

sentences.text: “报告！
sentences.translation: Report!
sentences.explanation: The sentence is a simple exclamation calling for attention or announcing something.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating a pause or omission in the text.

content.raw_text: 你突然敬了个礼。

sentences.text: 你突然敬了个礼。
sentences.translation: You suddenly saluted.
sentences.explanation: The structure '了个' is a common way to indicate completion of an action with a measure word in Chinese.

words.definition: (a measure word for 礼, indicating a salute)

sentences.translation: Ah?
sentences.explanation: The character '啊' is often used as an interjection to express surprise, realization, or other emotions. In this context, it is followed by a question mark indicating a questioning tone.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating a pause or continuation in the text.

content.raw_text: 老张一愣。

sentences.text: 老张一愣。
sentences.translation: Old Zhang was stunned.
sentences.explanation: In this sentence, "老" is used as a prefix to address someone older or more experienced, similar to 'old' in English. "一" is a numeral indicating 'one' in this context. "愣" means 'stunned' or 'dazed'.

content.raw_text: “申请领导批准我一个小时的假，我要去领个结婚证！”

sentences.text: “申请领导批准我一个小时的假，我要去领个结婚证！
sentences.translation: I applied for the leader's approval for an hour off, I want to go get a marriage certificate!
sentences.explanation: The structure '申请领导批准' is a common way to say 'apply for leader's approval' in Chinese.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark followed by an ellipsis, indicating an unfinished thought or dialogue.

content.raw_text: 老张不愧是被你信任的好警察，在知道事情始末后，不但允许了你的请假，还带你去提前领了你的警号、警服、礼服，让你穿着帅气的警服去拍结婚照。

sentences.text: 老张不愧是被你信任的好警察，在知道事情始末后不但允许了你的请假，还带你去提前领了你的警号，警服，礼服，让你穿着帅气的警服去拍结婚照。
sentences.translation: Old Zhang truly lives up to being the good police officer you trust. After knowing the ins and outs of the situation, not only did he approve your leave, but he also took you to get your badge, uniform, and formal attire in advance, allowing you to wear the handsome police uniform for your wedding photoshoot.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of possessive particles in Chinese, as well as the structure of indicating completion of actions with the particle '了'. It also demonstrates the cultural significance of police uniforms and formal attire in certain situations.

words.definition: truly live up to; worthy of

content.raw_text: 民政局结婚大厅里，穿着警服的你，以及依偎在你身旁的漂亮女朋友，成为了众人眼中的一道风景。

sentences.text: 民政局结婚大厅里，穿着警服的你，以及依偎在你身旁的漂亮女朋友，成为了众人眼中的一道风景。
sentences.translation: In the marriage hall of the Civil Affairs Bureau, you in police uniform, along with your pretty girlfriend snuggled up next to you, became a sight in the eyes of the crowd.
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes a scene where the person in police uniform and their pretty girlfriend are noticed by the crowd in the marriage hall of the Civil Affairs Bureau.

content.raw_text: “来来来，新郎新娘看这里，准备拍照了，一、二、三……”

sentences.text: “来来来，新郎新娘看这里，准备拍照了，一，二，三…
sentences.translation: Come, come, the bride and groom, look here, getting ready to take a photo, one, two, three...
sentences.explanation: This sentence is a lively scene at a wedding where the photographer is getting the attention of the bride and groom to take a photo.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark followed by an ellipsis, indicating a pause or continuation in the text.

content.raw_text: 新、旧两位师傅站在一旁，笑眯眯地共同见证着你这一生中最幸福的时刻。

sentences.text: 新，旧两位师傅站在一旁，笑眯眯地共同见证着你这一生中最幸福的时刻。
sentences.translation: The two masters, one old and one new, stood on the side, smiling together witness the happiest moment of your life.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains a structure where the adverbial particle '地' is used before a verb to describe how an action is carried out ('笑眯眯地' - smiling). It also includes the possessive particle '的' to indicate possession ('最幸福的时刻' - the happiest moment).

content.raw_text: “恭喜新婚！”

sentences.text: “恭喜新婚！
sentences.translation: Congratulations on your marriage!
sentences.explanation: The sentence is a simple expression of congratulations for a newlywed couple. The phrase '恭喜新婚' is commonly used in Chinese culture to wish happiness and blessings to the newly married couple.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark followed by an ellipsis, indicating a pause or continuation in the text.
